name: Nova
description: AI companion chat interface with multi-agent discussions, delegation, and voice.

slots.description: Optional installed extensions may contribute bounded agent context
Optional installed extensions may project events onto Nova LIVE

services.description: Owns the desktop Document Picture-in-Picture Nova chat lifecycle across RedLeaf app navigation

surfaces.name: Float Nova
surfaces.description: Compact Nova discussions and chat in a separate desktop always-on-top window.
limitations: The opener RedLeaf document must remain alive.
The RedLeaf Windows host restores and tracks native bounds across PWA lifetimes; browser-only hosts retain size but cannot restore position.
Foreground context capture attaches the opener RedLeaf viewport to the selected Float discussion without sending it.
Global push-to-talk leases the configured shared voice key through RedLeaf and is active only while Float Nova is open.

slots.description: Optional action layered over an agent avatar in the Nova chat UI

permissions.reason: Sonos bridge polling for LIVE timeline events
Smart-home plugin API polling (Spotify/Hue) for LIVE events
Agent workspace markdown files (memory, CLAUDE.md generation, journal)
Serve local image/video files referenced in chat (/file endpoint)
